raw.query:
WITH static AS (
  SELECT static_encoder_workers_effective, binding_window_effective,
         static_as_ingested, binding_as_ingested
  FROM provenance.v_grid_static_effective
), windows AS (
  SELECT window_name, span_h, c_star_as_ingested, c_star_effective,
         is_superseded, tp_star, n_star,
         gpu_hours_rtx5090_effective, gpu_hours_h100
  FROM provenance.grid_window_effective
)
SELECT s.static_encoder_workers_effective, s.binding_window_effective,
       s.static_as_ingested, s.binding_as_ingested,
       b.span_h AS burst4_span_h,
       b.c_star_as_ingested AS burst4_c_star_as_ingested,
       b.c_star_effective AS burst4_c_star_effective,
       b.is_superseded AS burst4_is_superseded,
       b.tp_star AS burst4_tp_star, b.n_star AS burst4_n_star,
       b.gpu_hours_rtx5090_effective AS burst4_gpu_hours_rtx5090_effective,
       b.gpu_hours_h100 AS burst4_gpu_hours_h100,
       round((s.static_encoder_workers_effective * b.span_h)::numeric, 2)
         AS burst4_gpu_hours_rtx5090_all_window_static,
       (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'window_name', w.window_name,
          'c_star_effective', w.c_star_effective,
          'is_superseded', w.is_superseded
        ) ORDER BY w.window_name) FROM windows w) AS per_window_breakdown
FROM static s
CROSS JOIN windows b
WHERE b.window_name = 'burst4'
raw.observed: burst4 per-window effective optimum: span 3.15h, C*=7, TP2x2, RTX5090 22.05 GPU-h, H100 12.6 GPU-h, is_superseded=false; all-window effective static baseline: C*=8, binding window burst2, giving 25.2 RTX5090 GPU-h over burst4.
raw.evidence: The numeric row matches the burst4 per-window oracle after rounding, but v_grid_static_effective defines the static baseline across all windows as C*=8 bound by burst2, so calling C*=7 and 22.1 GPU-h static-optimal without per-window scope overstates the denominator.
raw.fix: Relabel the row as the burst4 per-window optimum; if it is intended to represent the effective all-window static baseline, use C*=8 and 25.2 RTX5090 GPU-h for burst4 while retaining TP2×2 and 12.6 H100 GPU-h.
